Under the proposed agreement, for at least a 50-year term, Community First Development Corporation, (the “Developer”) will reserve 121 units for family households, whose incomes are at or below 80% of the Area Median Income (“AMI”).
CR-043-2023 would authorize the County to accept a payment in lieu of taxes equal to a $58.00 payment per affordable unit during the term of the PILOT agreement.
Revenues: Forgone tax revenues totaling approximately $19,400,416 over a 50-year period.
